headline: Appetite drops. [[Protein needs don't.]]
body: Why nutrition is half the job in GLP-1 care.

headline: Intake falls [[16% to 39%.]]
body: GLP-1 therapy reduces energy intake by 16% to 39% compared with placebo, through changes in hunger, fullness and cravings.
source: Mozaffarian et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2025

headline: Less food can mean [[less muscle.]]
body: Four expert societies list muscle and bone loss among the core challenges of GLP-1 care, alongside nutrient gaps from eating less.
source: Mozaffarian et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2025

headline: The protein target [[moves up.]]
body: The general adult allowance is 0.8 g/kg a day. Targets of 1.2 to 1.6 g/kg have been proposed during active weight reduction, set for each patient by a clinician.
source: Mozaffarian et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2025

headline: Training is [[the other half.]]
body: The advisory says GLP-1 therapy should be prescribed with structured exercise: strength training at least 3 times a week plus 150 minutes of moderate aerobic activity.
source: Mozaffarian et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2025

headline: Measure it, [[don't guess.]]
body: The advisory calls for checking strength, function and body composition, and names bioelectrical impedance as a practical point-of-care tool.
source: Mozaffarian et al., Am J Clin Nutr 2025
